messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging: Observability gap detected for customer PolarisBank (tenant_id=polaris-328) in eu-west-1 dedicated pool. Symptoms: traces missing from customer APM, logs present in host infra but not visible in customer VPC. Severity: P1 - customer-facing. First alert: 2026-03-15T02:13:09Z
ops-oncall: acked. I’m on it — switching to incident DM for quick sync.
elaine-s: I’m seeing successful ingress at the pool level but the tenant forwarder shows 0 writes to the tenant-forwarder-svc. metric: tenant_forwarder_writes{tenant="polaris-328"} = 0 for last 10m.
pranav-m: Confirming — logs are landing in redwood-infra/logs/eu-west-1 but trace packets are being dropped when the forwarder tries to assume tenant-role. Getting 403s on the STS call.
infra-sre: 403 on STS -> likely IAM role mapping issue between dedicated forwarder and customer VPC role. This looks like the per-tenant role token expired and auto-refresh failed.
kevin-r: @infra-sre any quick remediation? Can we re-issue role or fall back to global-forwarder? Customer is seeing missing spans in production dashboards.
dmitri: We can flip a temporary proxy to route outgoing trace writes to the global infra-forwarder while we restore role bindings. That avoids touching customer's VPC. Will need a short window for keys.
polaris-support: PolarisBank engineering on call (via email) says they’re getting user complaints about failed trace-based debugging — they can’t correlate their transactions. They asked for ETA ASAP.
ops-oncall: Runbook says: if tenant_forwarder_writes == 0 and sts_403, try rebind -> refresh role -> if not possible, enable global-forwarder-fallback. I’ll coordinate with infra-sre for the rebind.
infra-sre: Attempting role refresh now: 
```
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/polaris-forwarder-role --role-session-name refresh-2823
```
infra-sre: Command returned AccessDenied: not authorized to perform sts:AssumeRole. Looks like the cross-account trust got deleted during last config push.
elaine-s: There was a policy rollback earlier at 01:40Z for unrelated infra. Could be collateral.
pranav-m: OK. since rebind failed, I’m going to enable global-forwarder-fallback for tenant polaris-328. This will proxy traces/logs to global cluster (read-only for VPC) and ensure trace ingestion in our APM. Expect partial attributes (some VPC-specific metadata missing).
ops-oncall: Please post exact steps and ETA for customer update. Also tag support lead.
pranav-m: Steps: 1) toggle tenant.routing.override = global-forwarder 2) restart tenant-forwarder service (graceful) 3) verify trace ingestion via /internal/traces/last?tenant=polaris-328
Command snippet: 
```
redwood-admin set routing polaris-328 --target global-forwarder && redwood-admin svc restart tenant-forwarder-polaris-328
```
pranav-m: ETA ~7m to propagate, then 5-10m for traces to appear in APM.
log-forwarder-bot: Notice: queued messages for tenant polaris-328 are 12k, backlog ~3m.
kevin-r: Good call. @polaris-support you can tell customer: "We’ve detected an observability routing failure. We are routing traces via our global ingestion path as a temporary mitigation. You may see reduced VPC-specific fields but traces should resume shortly."
polaris-support: Confirmed — I’ll message them and set expectation: 15m for visible traces, engineering will be ready to validate.
dmitri: While fallback is enabling, we should capture and preserve the forwarder logs and STS error traces for postmortem. Save bucket copy: 
```
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-infra/forwarder-logs/polaris-328/2026-03-15/ ./polaris-logs-2823/ --recursive
```
ops-oncall: Also create a temporary support role for Polaris reps so they can view the global traces (read-only). PRANAV can you create and send the link?
pranav-m: Created read-only dashboard link: https://console.redwood.ai/apm/dashboards/polaris-328/temp-access/ (expires in 6h). Sent to Polaris via secure channel.
elaine-s: Fallback is active. I’m seeing traces start to appear in APM with latency ~200ms extra. Span attributes missing: network.src_ip and vpc_subnet.
polaris-support: Customer confirmed traces are back but they flagged missing request headers in spans. They can do basic correlation now.
infra-sre: Investigation: the cross-account trust policy was overwritten by an automation (deploy-cleanup) job due to an edge-case tag mismatch. We need to modify automation to ignore dedicated-forwarder roles. Opening internal ticket infra-2823.
kevin-r: For live mitigation, please keep fallback for at least 1 hour while we restore correct trust. Rolling revert would be risky if it fails again.
dmitri: Agreed — we’ll perform a controlled restore: 1) pause automation hooks, 2) reapply trust policy, 3) test assume-role, 4) remove fallback.
ops-oncall: I will update the incident timeline and set next update in 15m. Also escalating to Eng-SRE for follow-through on automation change.
polaris-support: Polaris engineer asks: will any user data be lost or misattributed due to fallback?
pranav-m: No data loss expected. Some metadata will be missing; traces will be ingested into our global tenant bucket. We’ll keep a mapping so when we flip back the tenant forwarder, correlation remains intact.
incident-bot: Update: Incident assigned -> ops-oncall, infra-sre. Severity remains P1.
infra-sre: Trust policy reapply in progress. Applying: 
```
aws iam update-assume-role-policy --role-name polaris-forwarder-role --policy-document file://trust-polaris.json
```
infra-sre: Test assume-role succeeded. tenant_forwarder_writes now increasing.
elaine-s: Seeing writes resume to tenant-forwarder-svc. Backfill job started for 3m backlog.
ops-oncall: Prepare rollback of fallback: ensure backfill completed and latency stable.
log-forwarder-bot: Backfill progress: 100% for polaris-328 queue.
pranav-m: Rolling fallback off now: 
```
redwood-admin set routing polaris-328 --target tenant-forwarder && redwood-admin svc restart tenant-forwarder-polaris-328
```
pranav-m: Monitoring. Traces appear with full attributes. Validating correlation keys.
polaris-support: Customer validated full trace attributes restored. They’re keeping engineers on standby to monitor for 30m. They appreciate the quick mitigation.
dmitri: Postmortem notes: - root cause: automation policy rollback touched dedicated forwarder trust - blast radius: single tenant polaris-328 in eu-west-1 - mitigation: global-forwarder fallback, read-only dashboard, trust reapply - followups: tighten automation exclusions, add STS assume-role alert for tenant write drop, improve runbook to auto-fallback when sts_403 observed.
ops-oncall: Filing incident report and assigning follow-ups to infra team (ticket INF-2823) and runbook owner (RB-17). Final status: service restored, monitoring in place. Closing updates in 60m unless regressions. :white_check_mark:
